title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Cure, Deferral and Resolution Settings by Plan
content:
This matrix shows, for each Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases plan, whether the maturity condition can be cured, whether a non-borrowing spouse deferral is available, and which settings govern closing a case by resolution.

## Cure

| Case plan | Cure permitted | Latest stage at which a cure is accepted | Record that proves the cure | Reinspection after reported condition repairs ordered within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Death of Last Surviving Borrower | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not a condition case) |
| Sale or Title Transfer | no | not applicable | not applicable | 0 (not a condition case) |
| Extended Health-Care Absence | yes | before the loan is called due | a reoccupancy certification | 0 (not a condition case) |
| Principal Residence Change | yes | before the loan is called due | a reoccupancy certification | 0 (not a condition case) |
| Property Charge Default | yes | before the case is referred to foreclosure | a repayment receipt | 0 (not a condition case) |
| Property Condition Default | yes | before the case is referred to foreclosure | a passing repair inspection | 15 calendar days |

Under every plan, the borrower's oral statement alone does not prove a cure.

## Non-borrowing spouse deferral

| Case plan | Case can enter a non-borrowing spouse deferral instead of being called due | Events that end a deferral period |
|---|---|---|
| Death of Last Surviving Borrower | yes | the non-borrowing spouse's death; the non-borrowing spouse moving out; the non-borrowing spouse failing the annual certification; a property charge default; a property condition default |
| Sale or Title Transfer | no | none |
| Extended Health-Care Absence | no | none |
| Principal Residence Change | no | none |
| Property Charge Default | no | none |
| Property Condition Default | no | none |

## Resolution

Under every plan, the record that resolves a case is a satisfied payoff case. The resolution types a resolved case may record are: paid in full, sale, short sale, deed in lieu, and foreclosure sale.

## Reading the matrix

- *Cure timing for the two occupancy plans:* the cure must come before the loan is called due.
- *Cure timing for the two default plans:* the cure must come before the case is referred to foreclosure.
- *A case under the death or sale plan* has no cure, no cure deadline and no cure record.
